**Opening:** `game-console.component.ts:237` `openInventory()` (triggered by the Inventory button, `game-console.component.html:9`) calls `MatDialog.open(InventoryComponent, { data, panelClass: 'inv-dialog-panel', maxHeight: '90vh' })` at `:242`.

**Data passed:** `InventoryDialogData = { characterId, sessionId }` (`inventory.component.ts:19`), injected via `MAT_DIALOG_DATA`.

**API calls it can make** (all via `GameApiService`, `frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts`):
- `getInventory` → `GET /api/character/:id` (reused endpoint; on `ngOnInit`, `:53-70`)
- `equipItem` (`:96`) → `PATCH /api/character/:id/equip` — toggle equip/unequip
- `dropItem` (`:100`) → `DELETE /api/character/:id/inventory/:itemId` — used both for "use potion" (healing computed client-side, never saved) and "drop"

Note: shop endpoints (`GET /api/shop/:id`, `POST /api/shop/transaction`) exist on the Worker but have no UI wired to this dialog yet.
